Our Mission

jailinmate.net exists to make it easier for families, attorneys, bail bondsmen, employers, and concerned citizens to find official inmate search tools for any county in the United States — quickly, for free, and without any registration.

When someone is arrested, their family often has no idea where to start. Which website do they go to? Which sheriff's office has the search tool? How do they check booking status? Every county does it differently — some have online portals, others require a phone call, and the search tools are buried deep in government websites that aren't easy to navigate.

That's the problem jailinmate.net solves. We've compiled, verified, and organized direct links to the official inmate search tools for over 3,100 counties across all 50 states, so you can find what you need in seconds instead of hours.

What We Do

  • Maintain a comprehensive directory of official county sheriff and jail inmate search tools
  • Provide step-by-step guides for searching each county's jail records
  • List direct phone numbers and addresses for county jails
  • Explain bail bond procedures, visitation rules, and booking timelines for each county
  • Keep links current and verified — broken links are updated regularly
  • Cover all 50 US states and over 3,100 counties

What We Do NOT Do

We want to be transparent about our limitations:

  • We do not host, store, or maintain inmate records ourselves
  • We are not a background check service and do not create criminal history reports
  • We are not affiliated with any government agency or law enforcement organization
  • We do not sell access to records — all search tools are provided by government agencies
  • We do not collect or store the names of individuals you search for
  • We cannot guarantee the accuracy or availability of information on government websites

Our Data Sources

Every link on jailinmate.net points to an official government source. Our data sources include:

  • County sheriff's office official websites
  • County jail and detention center portals
  • State department of corrections inmate search systems
  • Court record search systems operated by county clerks

We do not link to third-party record aggregators or paid background check services. If an official government search tool is unavailable online, we note the best way to contact the facility directly.

Who Operates This Site

jailinmate.net is operated by The jailinmate.net Team — an independent group of web developers and researchers dedicated to making public government information easier to find. We are based in the United States.

This site is not operated by, affiliated with, or endorsed by any county, state, or federal government entity. We are a private informational resource.

For questions, data correction requests, or to report a broken link, contact us at contact@jailinmate.net or through our contact page.

Privacy Commitment

We take your privacy seriously. We do not track the names or personal information of individuals you search for. We use standard analytics (Google Analytics) to understand site traffic in aggregate. For full details, see our Privacy Policy.

Advertisements on this site are served by Google AdSense. We have reviewed Google's program policies and are committed to maintaining a site that complies with all Google Publisher Policies.
